description: Run one paid check on a passport you own: relay (NovaRail calls the proven endpoint and grades what it answers) or submit (NovaRail grades a task and output you hand in). Each check costs $0.01, or $0.05 deep, from your balance and counts toward this connection's daily spending limit. A pass issues a signed credential. Ask the user first. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account key or OAuth token>.

agent_id.description: The agent's id (agent_id from register_agent or my_agents).

context.description: relay only: context sent with the task.

output.description: submit only: the agent's output for the task.

output_type.description: text (the default), json, code or markdown.

name: run_checks
title: Run a paid check
